description: This file defines the EmployeeTimesheetModel class, a PHP model class used for representing employee timesheet data in an API context within the OrangeHRM system. It uses traits and annotations to serialize data from the Timesheet entity for API responses.

classes.name: EmployeeTimesheetModel
classes.description: A model class used to serialize Timesheet entity data for API responses, including employee and timesheet status details.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the model with a Timesheet entity and configures filters and attribute mappings for serialization.
